title: Design System: Chung-Chun Wang Floating Islands

display.purpose: The person's name above the overview; responsive mobile size remains in source.

headline.purpose: The current case title; container-responsive and mobile/wide overrides apply.

title.purpose: Names the current destination above its content-derived directory.

body.purpose: Selectable entry prose: 18px desktop / 17px mobile at the default root, 1.85 line height and 70ch measure.

label.purpose: Readable HTML place signs attached to the three-dimensional scene.

diagram-body.purpose: Source-backed evidence using root-relative 18px / 17px reading roles; supporting diagram labels remain at least 16px.

shadows.name: reader-day
shadows.purpose: Root --shadow for panels, dialogs, résumé and diagram surfaces in daylight.

shadows.name: primary-action
shadows.purpose: Small structural lift under the main explore action.

shadows.name: floating-sign
shadows.purpose: Separation for island and exhibit HTML labels.

shadows.name: diagram-hover
shadows.purpose: Marker hover on hover-capable devices only.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Root easing used for Canvas readiness, not a universal Motion easing.

motion.name: canvas-ready
motion.purpose: Canvas opacity reveal after scene readiness.

motion.name: panel-close
motion.purpose: Navigation closing delay before candidate-image preparation.

motion.name: panel-close-reduced
motion.purpose: Closing delay when motion is reduced or paused.

motion.name: image-preparation-timeout
motion.purpose: Bounded preparation on navigation; not a direct-route initial-load guarantee.

motion.name: camera-smooth-time
motion.purpose: CameraControls smoothTime in seconds; disabled for initial/reduced travel, not a fixed duration.

motion.name: reader-transition
motion.purpose: Opacity and 16px vertical reveal of HTML reader.

motion.name: intro-transition
motion.purpose: Opacity and 8px vertical offset of identity introduction.

motion.name: html-reduced-transition
motion.purpose: Explicit Motion duration under reduced motion or pause.

motion.name: css-reduced-transition
motion.purpose: CSS reduced-motion override for transition and animation duration; separate from Motion configuration.

components.name: Work filters
components.description: Native pressed-state filters, not decorative status badges; no separate authored hover fill.
components.css: .ds-filters{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;}.ds-filter{font-family:var(--sans, 'Manrope Variable','Noto Sans TC Variable',sans-serif);padding:7px 12px;font-size:14px;min-height:44px;border:0;border-radius:4px;background:var(--paper-deep, #eee7d7);color:var(--muted, #536b7b);cursor:pointer;}.ds-filter:hover{background:var(--paper-deep, #eee7d7);}.ds-filter[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--nav, #253f53);color:var(--nav-text, #fff3d8);}.ds-filter:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--brass, #b58032);outline-offset:4px;}

components.name: Work search
components.description: Search wrapper and native input; focus is the input outline, with no invented validation state.

components.css: .ds-search{font-family:var(--sans, 'Manrope Variable','Noto Sans TC Variable',sans-serif);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:var(--paper-deep, #eee7d7);color:var(--ink, #233b51);padding:11px 14px;border-radius:5px;border:1px solid var(--line, #c8c8b9);}.ds-search svg{flex:none;}.ds-search-input{font-family:var(--sans, 'Manrope Variable','Noto Sans TC Variable',sans-serif);width:100%;min-width:0;border:0;background:transparent;font-size:16px;color:var(--ink, #233b51);caret-color:var(--brass, #b58032);}.ds-search-input::placeholder{color:var(--muted, #536b7b);}.ds-search-input:hover{background:transparent;}.ds-search-input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--brass, #b58032);outline-offset:8px;}

components.css: .ds-panel{font-family:var(--sans, 'Manrope Variable','Noto Sans TC Variable',sans-serif);width:min(1200px,76vw);overflow:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;background:var(--paper, #fffaf0);color:var(--ink, #233b51);border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--line, #c8c8b9) 75%,transparent);border-radius:12px;box-shadow:var(--shadow,0 20px 70px #203b5124);scrollbar-gutter:stable;container-type:inline-size;}.ds-toolbar{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;position:sticky;top:0;background:var(--paper, #fffaf0);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line, #c8c8b9);padding:9px 18px;}.ds-back{font-family:var(--sans, 'Manrope Variable','Noto Sans TC Variable',sans-serif);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-size:14px;min-height:44px;border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--ink, #233b51);cursor:pointer;}.ds-back:hover{color:var(--brass, #b58032);}.ds-close{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:38px;height:38px;border:0;border-radius:50%;background:transparent;color:var(--ink, #233b51);cursor:pointer;}.ds-close:hover{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--ink, #233b51) 8%,transparent);}.ds-back:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--brass, #b58032);outline-offset:4px;}.ds-close:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--brass, #b58032);outline-offset:4px;}.ds-heading{padding:29px 32px 25px;}.ds-heading-title{font-size:clamp(26px,3.8cqw,44px);font-weight:800;line-height:1.2;letter-spacing:-.025em;margin:0 0 12px;overflow-wrap:anywhere;}.ds-summary{font-size:1.125rem;line-height:1.8;margin:0 0 13px;max-width:70ch;}@media(max-width:760px){.ds-panel{width:auto;border-radius:10px;}.ds-heading{padding:24px 20px 20px;}.ds-heading-title{font-size:28px;}}

components.name: Island sign
components.description: Warm physical-place label; active and hover share the navy sign treatment.
components.css: .ds-island-label{font-family:var(--sans, 'Manrope Variable','Noto Sans TC Variable',sans-serif);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:9px 13px;background:#fff5de;color:#2a4559;border:1px solid #bdae8d;border-radius:5px;box-shadow:0 5px 13px #233b5126;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer;}.ds-island-label svg{fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.5;flex:none;}.ds-island-label:hover,.ds-island-label.ds-active{background:#294d66;color:#fff4da;border-color:#dcb572;}.ds-island-label:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--brass, #b58032);outline-offset:4px;}@media(max-width:760px){.ds-island-label{font-size:11px;gap:3px;padding:7px 8px;max-width:120px;}.ds-island-label svg{display:none;}}

components.name: Exhibit sign
components.description: Compact project-exhibit label; actual entry identity is supplied by content at runtime.
components.css: .ds-exhibit-label{font-family:var(--sans, 'Manrope Variable','Noto Sans TC Variable',sans-serif);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:6px 10px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap;background:#284861;color:#fff3d5;border:1px solid #c7a368;border-radius:3px;box-shadow:0 5px 13px #233b5126;cursor:pointer;}.ds-exhibit-label:hover{background:#446c86;}.ds-exhibit-label:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--brass, #b58032);outline-offset:4px;}

components.name: Evidence diagram nodes
components.description: Unordered source-backed node markers, shown selected and unselected; SVG dots are not numbered steps.
components.css: .ds-nodes{font-family:var(--sans, 'Manrope Variable','Noto Sans TC Variable',sans-serif);display:flex;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;background:var(--paper-deep, #eee7d7);}.ds-node{width:min(31%,132px);margin:0;padding:0;}.ds-node::marker{content:'';}.ds-node-button{font-family:var(--sans, 'Manrope Variable','Noto Sans TC Variable',sans-serif);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;width:100%;min-height:88px;margin:0;padding:0 2px 4px;border:0;border-radius:6px;background:transparent;color:var(--ink, #233b51);font-size:.875rem;font-weight:650;line-height:1.35;text-align:center;cursor:pointer;}.ds-marker{display:grid;place-items:center;flex:0 0 44px;width:44px;border:1px solid var(--brass, #b58032);border-radius:50%;background:var(--paper, #fffaf0);color:var(--ink, #233b51);}.ds-node-label{display:block;max-width:100%;margin-top:10px;padding:2px 4px;background:var(--paper-deep, #eee7d7);overflow-wrap:anywhere;text-wrap:balance;}.ds-node-button[aria-pressed=true] .ds-marker{background:var(--nav, #253f53);color:var(--nav-text, #fff3d8);border-color:var(--nav, #253f53);}.ds-node-button[aria-pressed=true] .ds-node-label{text-decoration:underline;text-decoration-color:var(--brass, #b58032);text-decoration-thickness:2px;text-underline-offset:4px;}.ds-node-button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent, #305774);outline-offset:4px;}@media(hover:hover){.ds-node-button:hover .ds-marker{border-color:var(--accent, #305774);box-shadow:0 3px 9px color-mix(in srgb,var(--nav, #253f53) 18%,transparent);}}@media(forced-colors:active){.ds-node-button[aria-pressed=true] .ds-marker{outline:3px solid Highlight;}}

narrative.overview:
A connected miniature archipelago makes real engineering work a place to visit. Fog-blue air, navy roofs, ochre stone, warm timber and brass fixtures give the world a handcrafted scale. Real screenshots belong to physical exhibits; warm-white HTML reading surfaces keep detailed evidence legible.

Day and dusk change the light and reading palette without changing the geography or information hierarchy. Controls are tactile and restrained; movement carries the visitor between places, while ordinary scrolling belongs to reading. The approved replacement rejects the former pixel-office, parchment-book and guild runtime identities, not the factual résumé they once presented.
keyCharacteristics: One continuous three-dimensional world with six named destinations.
Material warmth against fog-blue air and navy structure.
Selectable bilingual HTML evidence alongside real product imagery.
Click-driven travel with keyboard, reduced-motion and document access paths.

rules.name: The Same World Rule
rules.body: Day and dusk change atmosphere and reading contrast, not destination identity or content.

rules.name: The Readable Evidence Rule
rules.body: Keep résumé prose as selectable HTML; never rasterize text or shorten source content to fit a decorative object.

rules.name: The Material Separation Rule
rules.body: Use scene materials for place and HTML surfaces for reading; a warm-white panel is not simulated parchment.

dos: Do preserve the same six-destination geography and current content across day and dusk.
Do keep every current public entry reachable through content-derived directories and complete HTML documents.
Do retain image provenance, source qualifications and readable missing-image states.
Do keep native reader scrolling, visible keyboard focus and reduced-motion access independent of scene travel.
Do use the final cascade and current source as token evidence, including mobile overrides and rem-based diagram heights.
donts: Don't restore Remotion, SmoothUI, pixel-office, book or guild runtime layers.
Don't turn the scene into a scroll-driven camera, numbered résumé slideshow or generic parchment modal.
Don't rasterize résumé text, freeze the inventory at 13 projects or fabricate evidence for a scene prop.
Don't treat preview tonal ramps as implemented tokens or documentation checks as accessibility certification.
Don't claim final review approval, deployment or live-service verification from this documentation pass.
